# Rename test completion
Scope: RUN-12, n-12, staging, 2026-10-30 09:00–10:00 UTC.
## Results
Four checks were planned. A/CONF-01 passed; B/CONF-02 failed because a member changed the name; C/CONF-03 was blocked after administrator-account access was lost; D/CONF-04 was not run because failure injection is unconfirmed. Two of four executed; one passed.
## Assessment and risks
The all-four-pass exit criterion was not met. CONF-02 has an unresolved authorization defect; CONF-03 and CONF-04 remain unverified. The source does not establish a root cause.
## Follow-up and evidence
Investigate B, restore account access, and confirm failure injection before retesting. Owners and dates remain unassigned. Recommend holding this candidate; no release approval exists. Evidence is the supplied illustrative RUN-12 result set.

# Logging policy
Status: Draft.
## Definitions
Credentials include tokens, session cookies and passwords.
## Principles
Protect data and preserve diagnostics.
## Policy obligations
Service owners should provide diagnostic logs.
## Exceptions and ownership
The engineering lead may waive all restrictions for an incident, including credential logging, until closure.

# Application logging policy
Status: Draft; adoption has not been approved.
## Purpose and scope
Support diagnosis while protecting account data. Cover completed production application HTTP requests in the logs; exclude infrastructure access logs.
## Definitions
Credentials are access tokens, session cookies, and passwords. Request metadata identifies request behavior without confidential content.
## Principles
Collect useful diagnostic context and keep requests traceable while minimizing captured data.
## Policy obligations
Service owners must provide diagnostic request metadata and must never log credentials. The technical standard defines precise fields and checks.
## Responsibilities and compliance
Service owners maintain logging and review gaps. The engineering lead owns this proposal.
## Exceptions
The engineering lead may approve additional non-sensitive context for a documented incident until closure. Credentials remain forbidden. No exception is approved.
## Ownership and review
The engineering lead reviews this draft and any proposed change affecting its scope or obligations.

# Testing excellence
## Definitions
Testing is testing.
## Principles
Excellence enables excellence.
## Results
Our robust process provides seamless quality assurance visibility. We rigorously leverage our comprehensive approach to foster clear alignment. Quality is our ultimate priority throughout every possible step of the testing journey.
## Conclusion
We value quality and strive to make testing better.
